description: This file contains the implementation of the AclEntryModified event class, which models an event emitted after a Thing's ACL (Access Control List) entry has been modified, including methods for construction, JSON serialization/deserialization, and related metadata.

classes.name: AclEntryModified
classes.description: Represents an event emitted when a Thing's ACL entry is modified, including serialization/deserialization and metadata handling.

methods.name: AclEntryModified.of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of AclEntryModified with specified parameters.

methods.name: AclEntryModified.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an AclEntryModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: AclEntryModified.getAclEntry
methods.description: Returns the ACL entry associated with this event.

methods.name: AclEntryModified.setRevision
methods.description: Returns a copy of this event with an updated revision number.

methods.name: AclEntryModified.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of this event with updated Ditto headers.
